data.rationale: The proposal follows the same path (menu/Agencies → Bridges & Tunnels → Tolls by vehicle → vehicle tile) and names vehicle type as a parameter, but it hedges on the entry point, adds an uncertain "Toll Rates" step, and leaves out the facility parameter, so an automation would need guesswork.
